text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after school.
While walking through the academy...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san.
Hello.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: There's a costume party in the cafeteria after this.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So I tried dressing up as a Healer
and becoming a resident of a fantasy world, but—

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Grass-senpai, you look wonderful!
It suits you so well~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Hehe, thank you very much.
I'm glad to hear I'm pulling it off well.

text_block_list.name: Braided Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the title "Healer"
suits you perfectly, Senpai...!
choice_data_list: Grass really is the soothing type, huh?
Grass really is the soothing type, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, my~ I am honored~.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That's true, but it's not just that.
...Back when we had just enrolled—

text_block_list.name: Braided Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah... What do I do...?
I can't keep up with everyone's level at all...

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...So this is the level of Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Braided Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right... Even if girls like us
try any harder—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What?! Grass-chan, you're still going?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You just recovered from an injury.
Even if the selection race is coming up, if you push yourself too hard...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry~
Pool training is specifically designed not to put stress on your body, after all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Besides...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything I can do, I want to see it through.
...For the sake of a run I won't regret.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You won't grow if you just despair
and shrink back from the current situation.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I see... Aaaall right!
I can't afford to lose either! Time to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪
Shall we go for one more swim then?

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Every time it got tough and we felt like giving up……
we remembered those words and kept pushing forward!

text_block_list.name: Braided Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"That's why, Senpai, you're a healer
who cast a spell of courage on me...!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Did I give her... courage...?
choice_data_list: That's such a Grass-like way to comfort someone, huh?
That's such a Grass-like way to comfort someone, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I am grateful to my fans, of course...
However, I run for my own victory.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...However, I never imagined that my efforts
could become a source of strength for someone else."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So Healers have this kind
of soothing magic as well.
choice_data_list: Let's keep running in a way that gives people courage.
Next time, I hope you'll cast some magic on me, too.
Next time, I hope you'll cast some magic on me, too.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So Healers have this kind
of soothing magic as well.
choice_data_list: Let's keep running in a way that gives people courage.
Next time, I hope you'll cast some magic on me, too.
Next time, I hope you'll cast some magic on me, too.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I can feel my morale soaring.
So much so that I want to burst into a run right this second.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "Come to think of it, we still have time before the party, so running a little bit shouldn't be a problem, right?"

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! Would it be okay if we
joined you? We won't get in the way!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
I won't be holding back, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having gained a new realization, Grass Wonder's running appeared more powerful than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all~.
Umm... Is something like this alright?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Take this! ♪ Recovery [Gain Heal]~!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaah!
Do one for us too, please~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, then allow me to do everyone at once...
Full Resurrection—Raise Natural~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing Grass Wonder soothing everyone around her with a smile... left me feeling deeply warmed and comforted.
